shared_elements: upright freestanding stela/monolith carved in relief
dense low-relief carving covering the full height of the shaft
rectangular glyph-like blocks arranged in columns/rows
monument set on stepped stone base/platform
justification: Both depict a tall upright slab-like monument whose face is entirely covered with dense low-relief carving, and both include rectangular block-like sign panels arranged in ordered columns, set on a stepped base. The decisive difference is that B is dominated by a large frontal standing human figure with elaborate headdress, ear ornaments and pendant regalia, whereas A's visible surfaces show only the panelled sign blocks and scrollwork with no figure discernible.
